newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Mannan loading 14,000 tonnes sugar using big bags. Sammarina II loading 2,509 tonnes bagged sugar. Virana loading 30,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load bagged sugar and three to load bulk.
Road: 242 trucks carrying sugar arrived on July 24.

Vessels: Icarus, Seanav I, Libanus and George B. each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Nordpol loading 41,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Delta Freedom loading 13,125 tonnes sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and five to load sugar (unspecified).

At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and two unspecified. Stocks: 11,661 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
